name: agent-ide
description: Agent IDE coding-companion skill exposing the bounded ide.start/context/diff/inspect/stop/edit/outline/read/symbol/graph/test workflow for active-session source edits.

interface.shortDescription: Bounded ide.* workflow for active-session source edits
interface.longDescription: Loads the agent-ide skill so a coder subagent uses the eleven bounded ide.* tools (start, context, diff, inspect, stop, edit, outline, read, symbol, graph, test) when the Agent IDE MCP tools are active, with fail-open native fallback when they are not.
